title: Soil Properties Dataset
description: Schema for soil property datasets containing hydraulic and thermal parameters for various soil types. A dataset may define soil types directly, include other datasets, or both.

metadata.description: Metadata about the soil property dataset

citation.description: Citation or reference for the dataset

description.description: Description of the dataset source and methodology

includes.description: List of other datasets to merge into this one (bundled names or file paths). Resolved in order; the current dataset's own soil_types are merged last.

on_conflict.description: Policy when a soil type appears in more than one source: 'error' (default), 'prefer_first', or 'prefer_last'.

soil_types.description: Dictionary mapping soil type names to their properties

^[a-z_]+$.description: Properties for a specific soil type. Retention parameters are given either as Campbell-style ('b', 'psi_sat') or as native van Genuchten ('alpha', 'n') — exactly one of the two pairs.

ci.description: Volumetric heat capacity of dry soil [J/m³-K]

quartz_fraction.description: Quartz volume fraction of the solid matrix (0–1). Bundled mineral datasets are supplemented internally. Custom mineral datasets must provide this for the Johansen thermal conductivity model; omit only for named organic peat soil types.
